contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ FEL TEMP REPARATIO ; D/ D N CONST[...]

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a Nummus of Constantius II, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads FEL TEMP REPARATIO. Reverse shows soldier advancing left, spearing fallen horseman. Mint is uncertain, AD c.355-361. Obverse legend reads D N CONST[...]. Obverse shows diademed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is very fine, die axis is 3 o'clock, weight is…
